description: As reparse-strict-reclose, but dt reaches u only after it advances over the empty e. So the strict prediction of u by c's written [T u] comes first, and its item of u is processed as strict, before dt predicts u in the ordinary way. That ordinary step makes the item of u ordinary, and the recognizer processes it again: it predicts x in the ordinary way and lets u complete empty, so d is a second reading. A library that keeps an item as it was processed while strict loses d and passes. This catches it where the queue of a set is first in, first out (engine §7.4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c | d
%rule a A [+T] V
%rule b A [+T] [+T] V
%rule c A [+T u] W
%rule d A dt V
%rule dt T e u
%rule e ε
%rule u x
%rule x ε | B
